title: Mothership at Langley incursion per Chris Mellon

tellings.quote: Chris Melon, former deputy assistant secretary of defense for intelligence under both Clinton and Bush. Yeah. Uh said that there was this mothership dynamic going on with the Hampton Air Force Base incursion as well where you have these little saucers flying out of a mother ship.

plain: During the 2023 incursions over Langley Air Force Base in Hampton, Virginia, small saucers were seen flying out of a larger mothership, according to Chris Mellon, a former deputy assistant secretary of defense for intelligence under Presidents Clinton and Bush. Michels passes this on from Mellon, calling it the Hampton Air Force Base incursion. If true, it would mean unknown craft were operating in coordinated groups over a US military base.
